title: Uniform Sampling of Proper Graph Colorings via Soft Coloring and Partial Rejection Sampling
summary: We present a new algorithm for the exact uniform sampling of proper \(k\)-colorings of a graph on \(n\) vertices with maximum degree~\(Δ\). The algorithm is based on partial rejection sampling (PRS) and introduces a soft relaxation of the proper coloring constraint that is progressively tightened until an exact sample is obtained. Unlike coupling from the past (CFTP), the method is inherently parallelizable.
